correctness.rationale: For invariant simplices the oriented chain trace is (-1)^{q+1}, q the number of selected edge-vertex transposition orbits, including empty face. The outside W-graph with cover number <=2 has weighted correction s(Z)=1-1_{I!=empty}-|U|+|I|+|C|. Exhaustive structural cases: a single edge yields n-1, two edges +1, triangle +1, square -1, others zero. Counting them gives reduced Lefschetz C(m-1,3). Published Jonsson H_3 and H_4 ranks plus published four-subset permutation H_4 character imply tr(H_3)=C(m-2,4)-C(m-2,3), hence positive and negative dimensions as claimed; rational finite-group transfer gives quotient invariant homology. Independently enumerated every two-covered outside simple graph n=2..5 and verified each s(Z) against these five types and Lefschetz 1,4,10,20, not merely cached VERIFY_OK. The unbounded proof is the explicit cover classification and binomial identity.
